definitions.gloss: to spread throughout; to reach every corner; to pervade
definitions.explanation: For something to be distributed or to extend to all parts or people without exception.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}き{渡|わた}った。
examples.english: The new textbooks were distributed to everyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}き{渡|わた}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time for the information to spread throughout the entire company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隅々|すみずみ}→隅々：16497_sumizumi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{行|い}き{渡|わた}った。
examples.english: Electricity reached every corner of the village.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go) + ⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (to cross over).
The combination means to travel right across something, leaving no part untouched.

COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - to reach everyone
・⟦{隅々|すみずみ}→隅々：16497_sumizumi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - to spread to every corner
・⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - information spreads
・⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - to keep an eye on everything

GRAMMAR:
Intransitive: the thing distributed is the subject (marked ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧), and the recipients or territory it reaches take ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{普及|ふきゅう}する→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧ - to spread (ideas, technology) through a society over time
・⟦{浸透|しんとう}→浸透：07593_shintou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to permeate, to soak in gradually
